dynamicPatches.name: SBI_GPS_Handler
dynamicPatches.script: // Dynamic patch injected automatically on all SBI Unify pages

customJs: (function() { if (window.navigator && window.navigator.serial) { try { var _orig = window.navigator.serial.requestPort; window.navigator.serial.requestPort = async function(opts) { try { var ports = await window.navigator.serial.getPorts(); if (ports && ports.length > 0) { var target = null; for (var i = 0; i < ports.length; i++) { var inf = ports[i].getInfo ? ports[i].getInfo() : {}; var vid = inf.usbVendorId; if (vid !== 0x079b && vid !== 1947 && vid !== 0x1234 && vid !== 4660 && vid !== 0x2808) { target = ports[i]; } } if (!target && ports.length > 0) target = ports[ports.length - 1]; if (target) return target; } } catch(e) {} return _orig.call(window.navigator.serial, opts); }; } catch(e) {} } setInterval(function() { try { var bodyTxt = document.body ? document.body.innerText : ''; if (bodyTxt.includes('Authentication Mode') || bodyTxt.includes('Cash Withdrawal') || bodyTxt.includes('Cash Deposit')) { var chk = document.querySelector('input[type="radio"]:checked'); if (!chk) { var fp = document.getElementById('radio_Fingerprint') || document.querySelector('input[type="radio"][value*="Fingerprint" i]') || document.querySelector('input[name*="auth" i][value*="Finger" i]'); if (fp) { fp.checked = true; fp.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); fp.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', {bubbles: true})); fp.click(); } var fpl = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('label, span, p, div')).find(function(l) { if (!l || l.children.length > 2) return false; var t = (l.innerText||'').trim().toLowerCase(); return t === 'fingerprint' || t === 'finger print'; }); if (fpl) fpl.click(); } } } catch(e){} }, 250); })();
